context: This criteria evaluates whether the solution correctly uses the request package's oauth option to automatically sign requests using OAuth 1.0 protocol with HMAC-SHA1 signatures.

checklist.name: oauth option usage
checklist.description: Uses the oauth option to provide OAuth 1.0 signing credentials and configuration

checklist.name: Consumer credentials
checklist.description: Provides consumer_key and consumer_secret in the oauth configuration

checklist.name: Token credentials
checklist.description: Provides token and token_secret (access token credentials) in the oauth configuration

checklist.name: Signature method
checklist.description: Specifies or relies on default HMAC-SHA1 signature_method

checklist.name: Automatic signing
checklist.description: Relies on automatic OAuth signature generation and Authorization header construction
